owner_and_capability: Care Plan exposes public account-scoped child, enrollable-phase and enrollment-request projections. Parent Portal owns the read ports and DTOs it consumes. Root binds and translates; Security Runtime remains authoritative for stored relationship permission values. Partial Refs #4073.
affected_tables: None: keys, values, defaults, SQL, schema and tenant/relationship scoping are unchanged.
atomic_cutover: Replace the five models/parent edges with workflow-owned DTOs and read ports. Care Plan public query contracts contain typed permission facts and calendar.Date, not persistence records or map[string]any. Its owned Postgres adapters convert the retained projections using the required root-supplied Security Runtime predicate. The root translates public values to the consumer values; production and existing typed fixture roots assemble the same capability. Existing person-name/soft-delete and existing-student audience projection rules move from compose to the same owner application, preserving sorting, contexts and queries. No Go package relocation, new role, rule, owner or grant. Admin units of work, relationship checks, routes, JSON fields, redaction facts, nil/empty/error semantics and inclusive final care day remain. The HTTP response seam retains its existing date string type: the new calendar.Date domain values convert explicitly so an unset date stays an empty wire string rather than changing to null. A regression covers unset/valid/omitted dates. Keys214->209; #4073 40->35; rules893 unchanged; composition1657 unchanged; Care Plan compose4509->4334, Portal compose507->506, total67428->67252. The two measured compose registers and total shrink accordingly.
